class JointLexicalEmbedding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original_id, lexical_state):
        super().__init__()
        self.id_embedding = original_id
        self.num_embeddings = original_id.num_embeddings
        self.embedding_dim = original_id.embedding_dim
        self.padding_idx = 0
        self.register_buffer(
            "flat_tokens", torch.tensor(lexical_state["flat_tokens"], dtype=torch.long)
        )
        self.register_buffer(
            "offsets", torch.tensor(lexical_state["offsets"], dtype=torch.long)
        )
        self.tokens = nn.EmbeddingBag(
            len(lexical_state["vocabulary"]) + 2,
            lexical_state["token_dim"],
            mode="mean",
            padding_idx=0,
            include_last_offset=True,
        )
        nn.init.normal_(self.tokens.weight, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.tokens.weight[0].zero_()
        self.projection = nn.Linear(
            lexical_state["token_dim"], self.embedding_dim, bias=False
        )
        self.lexical_norm = nn.LayerNorm(
            self.embedding_dim, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-5
        )
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(float(lexical_state["gate_init"])))
        # Xavier has no single item-count-independent standard deviation. Record
        # the actual initialized nonpadding ID RMS before any optimization.
        self.register_buffer(
            "sigma_id", original_id.weight[1:].detach().float().square().mean().sqrt()
        )

    def forward(self, item_ids):
        shape = item_ids.shape
        unique, inverse = torch.unique(item_ids.reshape(-1), return_inverse=True)
        if unique.numel() == 0:
            return self.id_embedding(item_ids)
        starts = self.offsets[unique]
        lengths = self.offsets[unique + 1] - starts
        bag_offsets = torch.cat([lengths.new_zeros(1), lengths.cumsum(0)])
        bag_indices = torch.repeat_interleave(
            torch.arange(unique.numelel(), device=item_ids.device),
            lengths,
        )
        positions = (
            starts[bag_indices]
            + torch.arange(bag_indices.numel(), device=item_ids.device)
            - bag_offsets[bag_indices]
        )
        pooled = self.tokens(self.flat_tokens[positions], bag_offsets)
        residual = self.lexical_norm(self.projection(pooled))
        residual = residual * (lengths > 0).unsqueeze(-1)
        effective = (
            self.id_embedding(unique) + self.gate.sigmoid() * self.sigma_id * residual
        )
        effective = effective * (unique != 0).unsqueeze(-1)
        return effective[inverse].reshape(*shape, self.embedding_dim)

class JointLexicalEmbedding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original_id, lexical_state):
        super().__init__()
        if lexical_state.get("tokenizer_version") != 2:
            raise ValueError("Expected lexical preprocessing version 2")
        self.id_embedding = original_id
        self.num_embeddings = original_id.num_embeddings
        self.embedding_dim = original_id.embedding_dim
        self.padding_idx = original_id.padding_idx
        self.norm_epsilon = float(lexical_state["norm_epsilon"])
        self.ratio_cap = float(lexical_state["ratio_cap"])
        if self.norm_epsilon <= 0.0 or self.ratio_cap <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("Lexical numerical safeguards must be positive")
        for name in ("title", "description"):
            ids = torch.as_tensor(lexical_state[f"{name}_ids"], dtype=torch.long)
            mask = torch.as_tensor(lexical_state[f"{name}_mask"], dtype=torch.bool)
            expected = (self.num_embeddings, int(lexical_state[f"{name}_limit"]))
            if tuple(ids.shape) != expected or tuple(mask.shape) != expected:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid {name} token-table shape")
            if not torch.equal(mask, ids.ne(0)) or ids[0].ne(0).any():
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid {name} padding mask")
            if (ids < 0).any() or (ids >= len(lexical_state["vocabulary"]) + 2).any():
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid {name} vocabulary IDs")
            self.register_buffer(f"{name}_ids", ids.clone())
            self.register_buffer(f"{name}_mask", mask.clone())
        self.register_buffer(
            "text_present",
            self.title_mask.any(dim=-1) | self.description_mask.any(dim=-1),
        )
        self.tokens = nn.Embedding(
            len(lexical_state["vocabulary"]) + 2,
            int(lexical_state["token_dim"]),
            padding_idx=0,
        )
        nn.init.normal_(self.tokens.weight, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.tokens.weight[0].zero_()
        self.projection = nn.Linear(
            2 * int(lexical_state["token_dim"]), self.embedding_dim, bias=False
        )
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.projection.weight)
        scale = float(lexical_state["initial_scale"])
        if not 0.0 < scale < 1.0:
            raise ValueError("initial_scale must be strictly between zero and one")
        self.scale_logit = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(scale / (1.0 - scale))))

    def _pool_field(self, selected, name):
        ids = getattr(self, f"{name}_ids")[selected]
        mask = getattr(self, f"{name}_mask")[selected]
        offsets = torch.arange(0, ids.numel(), ids.size(1), device=ids.device)
        # Sum directly into field vectors, avoiding a rows x tokens x width
        # activation. All arithmetic here runs under disabled autocast.
        summed = F.embedding_bag(
            ids.reshape(-1),
            self.tokens.weight.float(),
            offsets,
            mode="sum",
            padding_idx=0,
            include_last_offset=False,
        )
        return summed / mask.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1).float()

    def _text_components(self, selected, identity):
        pooled = torch.cat(
            [self._pool_field(selected, "title"),
             self._pool_field(selected, "description")],
            dim=-1,
        )
        projected = F.linear(pooled, self.projection.weight.float(), bias=None)
        identity_norm = identity.float().norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).detach()
        projected_norm = projected.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        ratio = (
            identity_norm / projected_norm.clamp_min(self.norm_epsilon)
        ).clamp_max(self.ratio_cap)
        residual = self.scale_logit.float().sigmoid() * ratio * projected
        return residual, projected_norm, identity_norm, ratio

    def forward(self, item_ids):
        shape = item_ids.shape
        unique, inverse = torch.unique(item_ids.reshape(-1), return_inverse=True)
        identity = self.id_embedding(unique)
        if unique.numel() == 0:
            return identity.reshape(*shape, self.embedding_dim)
        rows = (unique.ne(0) & self.text_present[unique]).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        with torch.autocast(device_type=identity.device.type, enabled=False):
            residual = torch.zeros_like(identity, dtype=torch.float32)
            if rows.numel() > 0:
                values, _, _, _ = self._text_components(unique[rows], identity[rows])
                residual = residual.index_copy(0, rows, values)
            effective = torch.where(
                unique.ne(0).unsqueeze(-1),
                identity.float() + residual,
                torch.zeros_like(residual),
            )
        return effective.to(identity.dtype)[inverse].reshape(*shape, self.embedding_dim)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def numerical_diagnostics(self):
        # Deterministic, bounded training-only audit; no random draws or cache.
        ids = torch.nonzero(self.text_present, as_tuple=True)[0]
        ids = ids[ids.ne(0)]
        if ids.numel() > 1024:
            indices = torch.linspace(0, ids.numel() - 1, 1024, device=ids.device).long()
            ids = ids[indices]
        result = {"sampled_text_items": int(ids.numel()),
                  "gate": float(self.scale_logit.float().sigmoid())}
        if ids.numel() == 0:
            return result
        projected_norms, ratios, relative_norms = [], [], []
        nonfinite = 0
        with torch.autocast(device_type=ids.device.type, enabled=False):
            for chunk in ids.split(256):
                residual, norm, identity_norm, ratio = self._text_components(
                    chunk, self.id_embedding(chunk)
                )
                relative = residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) / identity_norm.clamp_min(1e-12)
                finite = (
                    torch.isfinite(residual).all(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                    & torch.isfinite(norm) & torch.isfinite(ratio)
                    & torch.isfinite(relative)
                )
                nonfinite += int((~finite).sum())
                projected_norms.append(norm[finite].float())
                ratios.append(ratio[finite].float())
                relative_norms.append(relative[finite].float())
            result["nonfinite_rows"] = nonfinite
            for name, values in (
                ("projected_norm", projected_norms),
                ("scale_ratio", ratios),
                ("residual_to_identity_norm", relative_norms),
            ):
                values = torch.cat(values)
                result[name + "_p10_p50_p90"] = (
                    torch.quantile(values, values.new_tensor([0.1, 0.5, 0.9])).cpu().tolist()
                    if values.numel() else None
                )
            values = torch.cat(ratios)
            result["ratio_cap_fraction"] = (
                float(values.eq(self.ratio_cap).float().mean())
                if values.numel() else None
            )
        return result
